relationships.subject: knee osteoarthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: The number of CGRP-positive cells was significantly higher in the OA group than in the sham group at four weeks postoperatively

relationships.subject: joint instability
relationships.evidence_quote: In conclusion, the reacquisition of joint stability is expected to reduce inflammatory pain in early OA.

key_findings: CGRP-positive DRG cells and SP/CGRP co-expression were higher in early ACL-transection OA than sham at 4 weeks, mainly in small cells.
Controlled joint movement did not significantly raise CGRP versus sham; no allodynia was observed in advanced OA.
